name: SchemaVersion
description: Layout version; must read 2.

name: Heartbeat
description: Changes once per cyclic call; use client staleness checks.

name: MonitorState
description: 0 disabled/invalid; 10 synchronizing; 20 between cycles; 30 cycle active.

name: CurrentShift
description: 0 gap or invalid clock; 1 day; 2 night.

name: CyclesThisHour
description: Completed measured cycles in the current clock hour.

name: CyclesPreviousHour
description: Last observed closed hour; inspect its key and partial flag.

name: Shift1Current
description: Running/latest shift 1 count; resets at its next 06:30 start.

name: Shift1Previous
description: Last observed closed shift 1.

name: Shift2Current
description: Running/latest shift 2 count; does NOT reset at midnight.

name: Shift2Previous
description: Last observed closed shift 2.

name: PreviousCycleSeconds
description: Held duration from accepted closing start through robot return.

name: BetweenCycleSeconds
description: Live known gap; only current when BetweenActive=1.

name: PreviousBetweenSeconds
description: Held gap captured at the next accepted start.

name: CycleSeconds
description: Live measured cycle, diagnostic only.

name: ThisHourKeyUTC
description: UTC day serial since 1990-01-01 * 24 + UTC hour; identifies repeated DST hours.

name: PreviousHourKeyUTC
description: Key for CyclesPreviousHour; -1 means no history.

name: Shift1Day
description: Start date serial since 1990-01-01 for Shift1Current.

name: Shift1PreviousDay
description: Start date serial for Shift1Previous.

name: Shift2Day
description: START date serial for Shift2Current, including after midnight.

name: Shift2PreviousDay
description: START date serial for Shift2Previous.

name: PreviousCycleValid
description: 1 when a complete measured cycle populated the held value.

name: PreviousBetweenValid
description: 1 when a known gap populated the held value.

name: ThisHourPartial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain current hour.

name: PreviousHourPartial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain held hour.

name: Shift1Partial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain running/latest day shift.

name: Shift1PreviousPartial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain held day shift.

name: Shift2Partial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain running/latest night shift.

name: Shift2PreviousPartial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain held night shift.

name: SignalsValid
description: Verified robot/input communication qualification, supplied by caller.

name: ClockValid
description: 1 = local and UTC calendar usable for this scan.

name: CycleActive
description: 1 only in state 30.

name: BetweenActive
description: 1 only in state 20; gap is known.

name: TimingFault
description: Latched tick discontinuity or duration saturation.

name: TotalCompleted
description: All complete measured cycles since initialization; not a lifetime production total.

name: GapCompleted
description: Completions during 06:00 through 06:29:59 local.

name: ClockUnassigned
description: Measured completions not assigned to periods because clock was invalid.

name: ClockReview
description: Latched invalid/discontinuous calendar.

name: CounterSaturated
description: A DINT reporting counter reached its maximum; it never wraps negative.

name: ObserverEnabled
description: Status: setup enabled, wiring reviewed and expected configuration present.

name: CyclesToday
description: Local CALENDAR day, midnight to midnight.

name: CyclesPreviousDay
description: Last observed closed calendar day.

name: TodayKeyLocal
description: Current local date serial since 1990-01-01.

name: PreviousDayKeyLocal
description: Date serial for CyclesPreviousDay.

name: TodayPartial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain current day.

name: PreviousDayPartial
description: 1 = incomplete/uncertain held day.

name: LocalDateYYYYMMDD
description: Readable current PLC local date.

name: LocalTimeHHMMSS
description: Readable current PLC local time; e.g. 63000 means 06:30:00.

name: CurrentHourLocalLabel
description: YYYYMMDDHH label, e.g. 2026092817; key UTC distinguishes repeated DST hour.

name: PreviousHourLocalLabel
description: Local label for held hour.

name: PartialObservationsSkipped
description: Synchronization boundaries/aborted active observations not counted as complete cycles.

name: IgnoredCloseEdges
description: Additional closing edges ignored while the current measured cycle was active.

name: RestartEvents
description: First-call/startup-reset events observed.

name: ConfigurationOK
description: Expected MM6 Servo and EUROMAP selectors both true.

name: ProductionMode
description: Verified production-eligibility input supplied by caller; setup/jog is excluded.

name: AbortActive
description: Verified observation-abort input supplied by caller.

name: CloseCommand
description: Snapshot of MM6 DB98.DBX112.7.

name: RobotPermit
description: Snapshot of MM6 DB94.DBX29.6.

name: Synchronized
description: 1 after a qualified robot low-to-high boundary has been observed.

name: LastCycleEndDate
description: Local YYYYMMDD at last measured completion; 0 if clock unavailable.

name: LastCycleEndTime
description: Local HHMMSS at last measured completion; inspect LastCycleEndDate for validity.
